name: John Cockerill India Ltd
title: John Cockerill India Ltd-$ - 500147 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Standalone revenue INR2,000m (+162% YoY) and order book INR13bn (+101%), but EBITDA only INR114m; consolidated EBITDA margin 1.4% with management targeting ~3% and >10% in three years.

capex.quote: capex is limited, it's not very capex intensive

triggers.label: Consolidated EBITDA ~3%, >10% in 3 yrs
triggers.quote: we have an EBITDA at around consolidated at around 3% and it will go step by step, not by way over what we are aiming is really be at more than 10% over the next three years

triggers.label: Standalone order book +101% YoY
triggers.quote: our stand alone order book stands at approximately INR13 billion and reflects a 101% year-on-year increase

guidance.quote: we have an EBITDA at around consolidated at around 3%
we are looking to be at around ideally 30% to 35%
we expect from the next quarter on improvement in margins

red_flags.label: Operating leverage absent; employment cost up 34% YoY
red_flags.quote: why did the employment cost shoot up by 34% on a Y-o-Y basis

red_flags.label: Fundraise deferred; US consolidation timing unclear
red_flags.quote: USA is we are still here also we are still investigating

red_flags.label: Other income ~INR66 crore questioned; opaque sources
red_flags.quote: the key source is right now more financial interest

red_flags.label: Volteron has no revenue; IP owned by promoter
red_flags.quote: Volteron has no revenue yet due to the fact that it is ready for commercialization only since few weeks

evasions.quote: we will revert with a better answer to be very honest
most of it is again interest, sir
